title: Compare toy effect-estimator errors
hook: Two stated cases: explore the bias-variance risk rather than an estimator's name.

doesNotKnow: How the bias-variance risk rather than an estimator's name affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines MSE, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the bias-variance risk rather than an estimator's name in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
